hypothesis: If candidate construction quarantines every record from any session containing an exact or near protected-evaluation overlap, all four otherwise-valid candidates from the contaminated historical session will be removed while the other 92 candidates remain unchanged.
failure_conditions: any candidate from a contaminated session survives
a clean-session candidate is removed by the new gate
the builder creates a training row
the implementation changes runtime reply behavior
the historical result is reported without binding the private source hash
evidence_boundary: V77 can show that known benchmark contamination is quarantined at session level. It cannot prove that the remaining historical sessions are non-benchmark, that their plans are correct, or that training on them improves cognition or dialogue.
